conversations_direct_pair_check.name: conversations_direct_pair_check
conversations_direct_pair_check.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_high_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" < "conversations"."direct_user_high_id")
        OR ("conversations"."kind" <> 'direct' AND "conversations"."direct_user_low_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_high_id" IS NULL)

invitations_target_check.name: invitations_target_check
invitations_target_check.value:
("invitations"."kind" = 'group' AND "invitations"."group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."party_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."game_session_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("invitations"."kind" = 'party' AND "invitations"."party_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."group_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."game_session_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("invitations"."kind" = 'game_session' AND "invitations"."game_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."group_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."party_id" IS NULL)
